owner: every command that dedupes its retries (functions/src/shared/commandReceipts.ts)
read: server only; a retry reads its own receipt in the command's transaction
migrationNotes: One replay-receipt collection since L8 of the Firestore consolidation: commandReceipts/{command}_{id} with command, requestHash, result, createdAt and expiresAt, and expiresAt (seven days for triggers, thirty for requests and webhooks; the TTL policy is approved by the owner, 18 Nov 2026).

functionEventReceipts, eventLiveCommandReceipts, eventChatAccessReceipts, organizerAudienceProjectionReceipts, organizerEntitlementReceipts, eventAttendeeAttendanceReceipts, eventOfferConfigurationReceipts, eventRegistrationReceipts, eventRuntimeDataRequestReceipts, organizerEventOfferActionReceipts and organizerEventOfferBatchReceipts stopped being written and keep their documents, with no client access; replay windows are short, so none were copied forward.

The event-assistance commands' replay receipts moved too (19 Nov 2026), reversing the 18 Nov keep: eventAssistanceAccountabilityReceipts, eventAssistanceCaseReceipts, eventAssistanceMembershipReceipts, eventAssistanceParticipationReceipts, eventAssistanceProgressReceipts (now two commands, departure and route), eventAssistanceRcsCallbackReceipts (trigger retention), eventAssistanceRuntimeConfigReceipts, eventAssistanceSettingReceipts and eventAssistanceStaffReceipts are read only by their own command's retry. Each result keeps the revision and live-state fences the replay re-checks; old documents stay and none were copied forward.

Offer actions, including the draft and offer steps a batch commit derives, share the mutateEventOffer command; a batch stores only its per-offer results and rebuilds the rest of its response, and its replay hash includes the acting manager, so a second manager reusing a batch request ID conflicts.

organizerEventSetupDefaultReceipts, participantProfileClaimReceipts, salesDemoReceipts and salesFitQueueReceipts stopped being written (commands updateOrganizerEventSetupDefaults, claimParticipantFormProfile, salesDemo and adminRefreshSalesFitQueue); every replay is revision- or source-fenced, so none were copied forward.
Consent, money, safety and audit receipts stay in their own collections.
